math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=\begin{cases}\left(3 a - 1\right)x+4 a,&x < 1\\\dfrac{a}{x},&x \geq 1\end{cases}\\\text{任意 }x_{1},x_{2}\in \mathbb{R},\ x_{1}\ne x_{2}:\ \left[f(x_{1})-f(x_{2})\right]\left(x_{1}-x_{2}\right)<0\\\Rightarrow f\!\left(x\right)\ \text{在}\ \mathbb{R}\ \text{上严格递减}\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 读清单调性要求

math_steps.explanation:
$$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=\left(3 a - 1\right)x+4 a,\ x < 1\\\text{斜率}\ 3 a - 1<0\Rightarrow a\in \left(-\infty, \frac{1}{3}\right)\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=\dfrac{a}{x},\ x \geq 1\\\text{倒数项系数}\ a>0\Rightarrow a\in \left(0, +\infty\right)\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: $x < 1$ 这一段

items.label: 两侧的值
items.math: \begin{gathered}\left(3 a - 1\right)x+4 a\ \text{在}\ x\to 1\ \text{时趋近}\ 7 a - 1\ (\text{取不到})\\f(1)=a\end{gathered}

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}x < 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left(-\infty, \frac{1}{3}\right)\\x \geq 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left(0, +\infty\right)\\\text{分界点 }x=1:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{6}, +\infty\right)\\\text{取交集}:\ a\in \left[\frac{1}{6}, \frac{1}{3}\right)\end{gathered}$$
